title: Celestin recording session
summary: He recalls only one recording session with Celestin, and cannot identify some titles.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you make any other records? There's one here we've wondered about, this is Jam Up. And when I'm with you.

I don't remember that. I don't remember either of these. I do remember the recording session that we had, but Sweetheart of TKO and Ta Ta Daddy, and we made others. Now, it may have been either of these two. It may have been both of them. I don't know.

We could check from the master number. Usually these numbers here on some of these, this is the serial number. They also have other numbers on there that tell what others were made at the same date. I think we could figure that out. Did you make more than the one date?
Well, the one, did you work with Celestan to make records more than the one time?
No, that was the only time. That was the only time.

Because during that time, they weren't recording very much, and it was only in recent years that he has made some recording. Within the past seven, eight years that the band, not seven, eight, well, I'll say ten years ago. Ten years, yeah. They made the records then.
Anyway, we can check and find the other titles then.
